Name: Destroyable Bushes
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b]Destroyable Bushes[/b] allows players to destroy bushes with an axe. By default, destroyed bushes drop small amounts of wood and regrow after 3 days. These features can be customized in the mod's settings.[line]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. [b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b]
2. [b]Download Destroyable Bushes[/b] from the Files tab, [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/DestroyableBushes/releases]the Releases page on GitHub[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/798245-destroyable-bushes]ModDrop[/url].
3. [b]Unzip Destroyable Bushes[/b] into the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.

[b]Multiplayer notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod should affect each player separately. Players who want to destroy bushes should install this mod and customize their own options as needed.
[*]Bushes will only regrow if the host player has this mod installed, based on their options. Farmhands' bush regrowth options will be ignored.
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Options[/size][/b]

Destroyable Bushes includes options to alter how much damage bushes take from axes, change the speed at which bushes regrow, limit where bushes can be destroyed, and more.

To edit these options:

1. [b]Run the game[/b] using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file in the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\DestroyableBushes[/i] folder.
2. [b]Exit the game[/b] and open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editing program.

See the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/DestroyableBushes]GitHub readme[/url] for more information about each option.

This mod also supports spacechase0's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. Players with that mod will be able to customize config.json options from Stardew's main menu.
[line]
[b][size=4]Commands[/size][/b]

This mod adds the following SMAPI console commands:

[list][*][b]add_bush[/b]: Creates a new bush of the given size. Bushes added by this command will regrow if that setting is enabled.
[*][b]remove_bush[/b]: Removes a bush. Bushes removed by this command will NOT regrow.
[/list]
For more info, see the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/DestroyableBushes]GitHub readme[/url] or use the [b]help add_bush[/b] and [b]help remove_bush[/b] commands.
[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

Destroyable Bushes supports translation of its [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] options menu.

The mod will load a file from the [i]DestroyableBushes/i18n[/i] folder that matches the current language code. If no matching translation exists, it will use [i]default.json[/i].

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files through GitHub, Nexus Mods, ModDrop, or Discord.
